## Parental OpControl 0.17.3

- Fixed the Luna moon vanishing when it was clicked. The chat is a child of the moon's rounded backdrop, and hiding that backdrop after the morph also hid the chat. The window stayed on top, invisible, and could swallow clicks in the area where it sat. The backdrop now stays visible with transparent chrome, so the chat stays on screen.
- Fixed the My OpControl sidebar tabs that stopped responding. The invisible Luna chat window from the previous bug was sitting on top of the kid window; only the yellow "Message my parents" button was outside it. With the chat visible again, the tabs work normally. The supervisor now uses one shared rule for the moon and the kid window and never stops or hides the other mode.
- "Message my parents" on the lock screen now opens a messaging panel owned by the lock overlay, so the overlay can never cover it. It uses the same conversation and delivery status, sends offline messages the same way, and is available in English and Spanish. The panel closes when the device unlocks and the kid window shows the same thread.
- The lock screen logo now keeps its original aspect ratio at 100% to 200% scaling. The screen follows the approved design more closely: Luna in the upper-left window pane behind the bars, twinkling stars, the correct pills and speech-bubble icon, and the text and button spacing from the reference.
- My OpControl: the "Set by your parents · view only" note is now in the title bar and wraps instead of overflowing; the theme button is in the title bar; cards use the reference corners; quick replies on Messages are pill chips that wrap only when needed.
- No data, account, PIN, family or Windows setting changes. Luna stays enabled with the same key. This release is installed on the X1 only; the Yoga is not updated.
